findings.description: The duplicate-label refusal ('rename or remove one with a document edit (dispatch doc-edit), then edit the ask') names a rename that doc-edit refuses. doc-edit replace 'Option A: fast' → 'Option A2: fast' exits 1 with only the content-rule text, because doc-edit refuses an edit that leaves the ask breaking its rule, and a rename leaves both lists. Removing one, then edit-ask, keeps every word. Sent to the architect; not counted as a failure under the architect's round 4 bar (a failure is a refusal that leaves the agent no path).
